verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at bentonow.com/llms.txt and a consolidated docs.md index, both returning HTTP 200. Docs pages are also served as .md files, and Bento ships agent-oriented guidance: an AI agent setup journey and Bento Skills, which tell agents when to use MCP, the CLI, an SDK or n8n and carry safety guidance. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs.
